name: BazarDor-web-B14-Ass-07
description: বাজার দর (BazarDor) – a Bangla grocery price tracker built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, HeroUI and Better Auth. See today's market prices, price changes and bazar-wise details.

paragraphs: আজকের বাজারের দাম এক নজরে Today's grocery market prices in Bangladesh, at a glance.

বাজার দর (BazarDor) is a Bangla web app that helps people track the daily prices of everyday essentials such as rice, pulses, oil, vegetables, fish, meat, eggs, milk and spices. Users can see how prices changed since yesterday, compare prices across different bazars, and explore each product in detail, all in one clean and responsive interface.
features: 📈 Daily price overview – an infinite scrolling price ticker, plus the
top 6 price risers and top 6 fallers of the day with ▲ / ▼ change badges.
🗂️ Category browsing and sorting – browse products by category, and sort
them by default order, price low to high, or price high to low.
